facts.text: I take dance classes at Rhythm and Soul.
I twisted my ankle two weeks ago during a Salsa class on Monday.
My ankle injury was a minor sprain.
I focus on my technique, especially in Salsa class on Mondays, to avoid future injuries.
I am planning to perform in the studio's upcoming recital in two months.
I am nervous about performing because I have never performed on stage before.
I am worried about my ankle and whether it is okay to perform with a minor ankle sprain.
I plan to consult my instructor, Jamal, about whether I should perform with a minor ankle sprain.
Jamal has been teaching at Rhythm and Soul for a while.
I am thinking of asking Jamal for additional private lessons to help me prepare for the recital.
